title: alchemilla contractilis
intro: Alchemilla contractilis, commonly known as Alpine lady's mantle, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine lady's mantle include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating skin conditions and promoting tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla contractilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
